elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) warrants that the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation agreed by the Parties.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The only stated conformance period is 90 days, and it applies to the Site rather than expressly to all software.
The professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty has no stated duration; the 90-day period applies only to Site conformance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy clause expressly permits repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site.
The remedy clause expressly permits a refund of amounts paid for the non-conforming Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly warrants that its performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: HDI warrants that the Site and delivered software or files are free of malicious code, but does not expressly extend that warranty to the Services themselves.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The 90-day conformance warranty applies to the Site; the clause separately refers to delivered software and does not expressly warrant that such software conforms to its documentation.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Services performance warranty has no express duration. The 90-day period is limited to Site conformance, so the required Services duration is omitted.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy clause expressly includes repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site.
The remedy clause expressly includes a refund of amounts paid for the non-conforming Services.
